description: Велосипедна інфраструктура міста Дубна is a dataset listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Дубенська міська рада. Велосипедна інфраструктура міста Дубна. Coverage: Дубенська міська рада. The publisher named on the listing is Дубенська міська рада. Its keywords include благоустрій, велосипед, дубенська міська рада, набор відкритих даних, інфраструктура. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, GEOJSON, CSV. The listing shows 2021-06-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
